scope: PNG filter-None noninterlaced RGBA on two original 513x259 rasters. This is a narrow screen and one primitive optimization; uniform warm <=2x parity is NOT established.
inputProvenance: HorizontalFlipInput.Create / OriginalPixels.Generate, phase zero, zero alpha at both first-row ends, hidden RGB preserved. No external images or corpora.
changedPrimitive: Generated 32-entry ushort five-bit distance lookup with canonical long/unassigned-prefix fallback. Total arrays 4056 bytes within unchanged fixed 4096-byte scratch. Add 512 bounded construction units per compressed block, preserving exact consumed-bit work and all history/window/reserved-code checks.
uncertainty: Three-sample independent screens guide priority only. Conservative upper divides managed 99.9% Student-t upper mean by the smaller native bracket lower mean, using the managed critical value with no fewer native samples. No certification of passing encode or other paths.
